pharaoh_piledriver: Egyptian desert funk-rap, 118 bpm, four-on-the-floor kick, slap bass, darbuka and riq grooves, oud riffs, punchy horn stabs, synth brass. Verses: deep raspy male MC, rhythmic spoken flow riding the beat. Chorus: big chantable female gang vocals, wrestling-entrance energy. Danceable and punchy, short instrumental break mid-song.
epistemic_sabotage: Electro-swing with breakbeat drums, 124 bpm, swinging brass samples, upright bass slaps, chopped vocal stabs, sidechain pump. Verses: sharp, playful female rap-talk, quick and witty. Chorus: catchy sung hook with male backing vocals, call and response. Cheeky, high energy, made for dancing, drop after the break.
trust_and_betrayal: Nu-disco funk house, 120 bpm, four-on-the-floor, rubbery bass, clavinet, disco strings, talkbox accents. Verses: male and female narrators trading lines like a duet, deadpan and dramatic. Chorus: soaring sung hook, both voices together. Groovy, glamorous, danceable, filter-sweep break.
alt_afrohouse: Afro-house, 122 bpm, log drums, shakers, warm sub bass, marimba riffs, chanted female chorus, smooth male spoken verses. Hypnotic, danceable, builds and drops.
alt_dnb: Liquid drum and bass, 174 bpm, rolling breakbeats, deep reese bass, jazzy Rhodes stabs. Verses: fast spoken MC flow, male. Chorus: euphoric female vocal hook. High energy, danceable.
alt_balkan: Balkan brass beat, 128 bpm, oompah bass, tuba, trumpets, clarinet runs, electronic kick. Verses: theatrical gravelly male narrator. Chorus: rowdy group shout-along. Wild party, danceable.
alt_boombap: Boom-bap hip-hop with funk samples, 94 bpm, crunchy drums, vinyl crackle, horn loops, scratches. Verses: confident female MC, rhythmic spoken word. Chorus: soulful male sung hook. Head-nodding groove.
alt_cumbia: Electro-cumbia, 105 bpm, güira, accordion riffs, synth bass, digital cumbia beat. Verses: warm male storyteller. Chorus: bright female sung hook with gang vocals. Sunny, swaying, danceable.
